Hi Ari —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our call you mentioned a 2.5–3x traffic spike projected for BlackFri weekend and interest in moving from your current 1.2M token/month hosted commit to a 4M token/month committed tier. To keep things tight on timelines, I sketched a short mutual action plan (MAP) and a proposed billing anchor for the commit uplift.

High-level proposed MAP:
- Week 1 (this week): Legal & Procurement review of amendment; Redwood provides draft amendment + pricing schedule (attached).
- Week 2: Procurement issues PO / countersign DocuSign; Redwood provisions committed capacity and schedules SRE onboarding call.
- Week 3: SE-led integration & stress test with sample load; enable burst window day-of for BlackFri.

Commercial summary (proposal):
- New monthly committed tokens: 4,000,000 tokens / month
- Price: $0.0009 per token (volume-discounted, subject to 12-month term)
- Burst allowance: additional 20% per month billable at overage rate $0.0012/token, or can be converted to temporary burst pocket for event days (ops-managed).
- Prorated invoice for month of activation.

I've attached a draft amendment and a MAP spreadsheet you can share with procurement. If these terms look in the right neighborhood, can we align on target PO date by next Thursday? That will give us time to lock provisioning before your spike.

Thanks —
Monica

Thanks Ari — answers inline below.

1) Provisioning timeline: once we receive a signed PO/DocuSign we can provision committed capacity and open the staged pool within 3 business days; full routing + throttle profiles usually complete within 5 business days. For your Oct 26 anchor, a PO signed by Oct 20 is a safe target.

2) Burst allowance: the 20% is a managed soft allowance we can enable as a transient burst pocket for event-days (ops-controlled). If you exceed burst pocket, overage is billable at the overage rate noted; we can also pre-allocate additional burst pockets for the month if you prefer to limit surprises.

3) SLA: higher committed tiers get an elevated latency SLO and 99.9% uptime target baked into the amendment; we can include a 5% service credit ladder for sustained breaches (details in the attached amendment).

I've attached the MAP workbook (redwood_map_cartwise_v2.xlsx) that breaks deliverables by ownership and dates. Ben will lead the onboarding ops, Jasmine will run the technical validation.

If Procurement can confirm PO cadence and billing anchor next week, we'll align Ops to your Oct 26 target.

Best,
Monica
